about: June at Store 014 on one map: which records copy each other, which observe the world, and what joining them across the shelf, the truck and the money finds. Generated by scripts/analysis/finale.py from the records in public/data/india-grocery and the three analyses' outputs.

joins.how: shipment and line: item and cases
joins.sql: SELECT count(*) AS compared, sum(CASE WHEN p.sku = n.sku AND p.cases_confirmed = n.cases THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agree FROM picks p JOIN notice n USING (shipment_id, line)
SELECT count(*) AS compared, sum(CASE WHEN n.cases = p.cases THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agree FROM (SELECT sscc, sum(cases) AS cases FROM notice GROUP BY sscc) n JOIN pallets p USING (sscc)

joins.how: shipment and line: item and units
joins.sql: SELECT count(*) AS compared, sum(CASE WHEN r.sku_booked = n.sku AND r.units_booked = n.units THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agree FROM receipts r JOIN notice n ON r.shipment_id = n.shipment_id AND r.line = n.line

joins.how: item: the last receipt before each count survives it
joins.sql: WITH pairs AS (SELECT c.count_ts, c.sku, c.adjustment, r.units_booked, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.count_ts, c.sku ORDER BY r.received_ts DESC) AS k FROM stock_counts c JOIN receipts r ON r.sku_booked = c.sku AND r.received_ts < c.count_ts) SELECT count(*) AS compared, sum(CASE WHEN adjustment > -0.5 * units_booked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agree FROM pairs WHERE k = 1

joins.how: item and day: yesterday's book, plus receipts and deliveries, minus sales and write-offs, plus counts
joins.sql: WITH inflow AS (SELECT CAST(received_ts AS DATE) AS date, sku_booked AS sku, sum(units_booked) AS u FROM receipts GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT CAST(delivery_ts AS DATE), sku, sum(units) FROM fresh GROUP BY ALL), adj AS (SELECT CAST(count_ts AS DATE) AS date, sku, sum(adjustment) AS a FROM stock_counts WHERE strftime(count_ts, '%H:%M') < '22:00' GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT CAST(count_ts AS DATE) + 1, sku, sum(adjustment) FROM stock_counts WHERE strftime(count_ts, '%H:%M') >= '22:00' GROUP BY ALL), d AS (SELECT b.date, b.sku, b.book_on_hand_close AS book, lag(b.book_on_hand_close) OVER (PARTITION BY b.sku ORDER BY b.date) AS prev, coalesce((SELECT sum(u) FROM inflow i WHERE i.date = b.date AND i.sku = b.sku), 0) AS inflow, coalesce((SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM daily_sales s WHERE s.date = b.date AND s.sku = b.sku), 0) AS sold, coalesce((SELECT sum(units) FROM write_offs w WHERE w.date = b.date AND w.sku = b.sku), 0) AS written_off, coalesce((SELECT sum(a) FROM adj WHERE adj.date = b.date AND adj.sku = b.sku), 0) AS counted FROM book b) SELECT count(*) AS compared, sum(CASE WHEN book = prev + inflow - sold - written_off + counted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agree FROM d WHERE prev IS NOT NULL

joins.how: item: the books against a count of shelf and backroom
joins.sql: SELECT count(*) AS compared, sum(CASE WHEN adjustment = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agree FROM stock_counts

joins.how: item and hour: stock on the books against a look at the shelf
joins.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT audit_ts, sku, status, CAST(audit_ts AS DATE) AS date FROM shelf_audits), b AS (SELECT a.*, coalesce((SELECT book_on_hand_close FROM book k WHERE k.sku = a.sku AND k.date = a.date - 1), 0) + coalesce((SELECT sum(units_booked) FROM receipts r WHERE r.sku_booked = a.sku AND CAST(r.received_ts AS DATE) = a.date AND r.received_ts <= a.audit_ts), 0) + coalesce((SELECT sum(units) FROM fresh f WHERE f.sku = a.sku AND CAST(f.delivery_ts AS DATE) = a.date AND f.delivery_ts <= a.audit_ts), 0) - coalesce((SELECT sum(qty) FROM till_lines l WHERE l.sku_scanned = a.sku AND CAST(l.bill_ts AS DATE) = a.date AND l.bill_ts <= a.audit_ts), 0) + coalesce((SELECT sum(adjustment) FROM stock_counts c WHERE c.sku = a.sku AND CAST(c.count_ts AS DATE) = a.date AND c.count_ts <= a.audit_ts), 0) AS book_at_audit FROM a) SELECT count(*) AS compared, sum(CASE WHEN (status = 'empty') = (book_at_audit <= 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agree FROM b

joins.how: bill: every bill on the till lines has one approved payment
joins.sql: SELECT count(*) AS compared, sum(CASE WHEN approved = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agree FROM (SELECT l.bill_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM till_payments p WHERE p.bill_id = l.bill_id AND p.till_status = 'approved') AS approved FROM (SELECT DISTINCT bill_id FROM till_lines WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01') l)

joins.how: RRN: approved UPI payments against the provider's status and amount
joins.sql: SELECT count(*) AS compared, sum(CASE WHEN p.status = 'success' AND p.amount_inr = t.amount_inr THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agree FROM till_payments t LEFT JOIN provider p USING (rrn) WHERE t.tender = 'UPI' AND t.till_status = 'approved'

joins.how: amount and time: timeouts against the provider's final status
day: each settlement against the previous day's successes
joins.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT CAST(status_ts AS DATE) + 1 AS settlement_date, count(*) AS credits, round(sum(amount_inr), 2) AS gross FROM provider WHERE status = 'success' GROUP BY ALL) SELECT count(*) AS compared, sum(CASE WHEN x.upi_credits = coalesce(s.credits, 0) AND abs(x.gross_inr - coalesce(s.gross, 0)) <= 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agree FROM settlements x LEFT JOIN s USING (settlement_date)

joins.how: RRN: each refund names a success for the same amount
joins.sql: SELECT count(*) AS compared, sum(CASE WHEN p.status = 'success' AND p.amount_inr = r.amount_inr THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agree FROM refunds r LEFT JOIN provider p USING (rrn)

picks.name: Pick confirmations
picks.written_by: a scan of the slot's label as the picker takes the cases
picks.sees: where the picker stood, not what they took

notice.name: Shipping notice
notice.written_by: the warehouse system, from the pick confirmations

labels.name: Pallet labels
labels.written_by: the warehouse system, from the notice; no pallet was weighed

receipts.name: Goods receipts
receipts.written_by: a scan of the pallet label at the store, matched to the notice

corrections.name: Warehouse corrections
corrections.written_by: a count of a warehouse slot
corrections.sees: what is left in a slot

book.name: Book stock
book.written_by: the store's system, from receipts, sales, write-offs and counts

lines.name: Till lines
lines.written_by: a scan of each item at the till
lines.sees: a sale proves the item was there; no sale proves nothing

counts.name: Stock counts
counts.written_by: staff counting the shelf and the backroom
counts.sees: what is on the shelf and in the backroom

audits.name: Shelf audits
audits.written_by: a person looking at the shelf
audits.sees: whether the shelf has the item

payments.name: Till payments
payments.written_by: the till: the provider's answer, or its own timeout

provider.name: Provider's UPI report
provider.written_by: UPI's final status for every payment
provider.sees: whether the customer was debited and the store credited

settlements.name: Settlements
settlements.written_by: the store's bank, from the provider's successes

complaints.name: Complaints
complaints.sees: a customer's account, if they call

kpis.name: On-shelf availability
kpis.rule: Book stock is a belief. When an item stops selling while the books show stock, ask for a shelf check.

kpis.name: On time, in full (OTIF)
kpis.rule: A receipt booked by scanning a pallet label is a copy of the notice. Check it against the next count.

kpis.name: Payment success rate
kpis.rule: A timeout is a question, not a failure. Match it to the provider's final status before calling it failed.

rules: Before acting on a KPI, find the record it reads. If that record is a copy, find an observation that can contradict it, and join it.
A join that has never disagreed is a copy. A test on it can only pass.
Silence and timeouts are questions: no sale while the books show stock, and no answer from the bank, are not zeros.
When an observation disagrees, follow the copies back to the event that wrote them, across departments.
Name the things no record looks at. In June at Store 014, nothing looked at what was on a pallet.

trace.sql:
WITH silent AS (                       -- the store: no 5 kg sale since 16:00, with 63 on the books
  SELECT 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AS sku, TIMESTAMP '2026-06-23T20:00' AS at),
receipt AS (                           -- the books: the last receipt of the item before the silence
  SELECT r.* FROM receipts r, silent s WHERE r.sku_booked = s.sku AND r.received_ts <= s.at
  ORDER BY r.received_ts DESC LIMIT 1),
line AS (                              -- the receipt copied the notice; the notice copied the pick
  SELECT p.pick_ts, p.shipment_id, p.line, p.sku, p.slot, p.cases_confirmed, p.confirmed_by, n.sscc, n.units
  FROM picks p JOIN notice n USING (shipment_id, line) JOIN receipt r USING (shipment_id, line)),
nearby AS (                            -- the warehouse: corrections in the same aisle and bay since the pick
  SELECT c.* FROM dc_corrections c, line l, silent s
  WHERE c.adjusted_ts BETWEEN l.pick_ts AND s.at AND split_part(c.slot, '-', 1) || split_part(c.slot, '-', 2)
        = split_part(l.slot, '-', 1) || split_part(l.slot, '-', 2) AND c.slot <> l.slot)
SELECT l.shipment_id, l.line, l.sscc, l.sku AS noticed_sku, l.units AS noticed_units, l.cases_confirmed,
       l.slot AS pick_slot, l.confirmed_by, l.pick_ts, r.grn_id, r.received_ts, r.receipt_method,
       c.adjusted_ts, c.sku AS short_sku, c.slot AS short_slot, c.cases AS short_cases, c.units AS short_units,
       c.reason
FROM line l, receipt r, nearby c WHERE c.cases = -l.cases_confirmed
